chapter_title: Concerning the Twelve Signs of the Zodiac and the
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:** Whether these twelve dominant evils that are fixed upon the external natural mind, or these five principal falsities that move actively among them — both are ruling powers, each according to its own quality of evil. They are all in mutual opposition and hostility to one another: each oppresses and threatens the other. They plunder one another through the operation of Divine Providence, which has ordered all the planes of the mind. Providence has gathered [GAP-1] and confined them within the revolving order of the external mind, which cycles perpetually. Now, while that order revolves and overturns them, they enact everything they desire, in the interior and exterior regions of the mind, according to their appetite. Nevertheless, a divine guardian is set over them, an exactor above them — compelling, extracting, and removing from them whatever good they have seized.

---

**¶3:** Now this is how the matter may rightly be understood in its spiritual sense. These ruling evils were seized from the five genera of evil in the unregenerate will, and confined within the revolving order of the external mind. Two dominant evils were drawn from each genus. The paired evils of duplicity and violent persuasion belong to the genus of obscured self-intelligence — which is the rational mind darkened by its own reasoning. In contrast, the evils of aggressive dominion and the burning pride of self-love belong to the genus of infernal self-love. The evils of vacillating falsity, unstable persuasion, and calculated self-justification belong to the genus of inflated fantasy and vain imagination. The evils of enveloping anxiety, of servile falsity, and of sensual delusion belong to the genus of corrupted natural truth. The evils of cold contraction and venomous treachery belong to the genus of profound spiritual darkness and ignorance. These are the twelve ruling evils of depravity, which wickedness shall not [GAP-2] — for they cause all the evil and [GAP-3: destruction and corruption in the mind], whether in perception or in the voluntary life.

---

**¶4:** And understand also concerning these five principal falsities, the leaders among the evils: from what origin were they formed? The falsity corresponding to Jupiter was generated from the genus of obscured self-intelligence — that is, the rational mind reasoning from its own darkness. In contrast, the falsity corresponding to Venus came into being from the genus of self-love and its burning desire. And then the falsity corresponding to Mars belongs to the genus of inflated fantasy and forceful persuasion. The falsity corresponding to Mercury belongs to the genus of corrupted natural truth. The falsity corresponding to Saturn belongs to the genus [GAP-4] of profound spiritual darkness and total ignorance of good.

---

**¶5:** And also the two ascending drives are reckoned to self-love and concupiscence — that which is void of truth and that which is saturated with falsity. These are the originating father and the conceiving mother of all these evils.

---

**¶6:** And also divine good and divine truth, which are reckoned among them as a governing principle — ⟨reckoned as though of their kind, but why were they counted among them?⟩ — so that they would exercise dominion over them. You will discover that they subjugate the evils and falsities at every moment.

---

**¶7:** These seven we have named — the five principal falsities and the two originating drives of self-love and concupiscence: they are the agents of wickedness that produce every evil and destructive act in every region of the mind, the whole of it, interior and exterior, in every created faculty, in what is void of truth and in what is saturated with falsity, in perception and in the voluntary life.

---

**¶8:** [GAP-5] These ruling evils are distributed and appointed to four quarters of the mind, three per orientation in these four fundamental regions. And they are fixed to the revolving order of the external mind. The evils of aggressive dominion, burning pride, and violent persuasion — these three belong to a single quarter. In contrast, the evils of vacillating falsity, cold contraction, and servile falsity — these other three belong to another quarter. And then the evils of duplicity, calculated self-justification, and unstable persuasion belong to another quarter. The evils of venomous treachery, sensual delusion, and enveloping anxiety belong to another corner. Now they are placed thus, appointed to these four regions, and distributed upon the revolving order of the external mind.

---

**¶9:** So when the quarter of aggressive dominion, burning pride, and violent persuasion is plundered by the divine guardian set over it, who extracts from it, and by the leading falsities that move upon it — at that instant affliction shall strike all the natural affections below, the animal impulses of the will. However, when [GAP-6] the quarter of vacillating falsity, servile falsity, and cold contraction is plundered, [GAP-7] affliction shall at once befall the natural perceptions, together with the germinating knowledges and all the works that grow from the mind's understanding. Yet again, when the quarter of venomous treachery, sensual delusion, and enveloping anxiety is plundered, scarcity shall befall the truths in the external mind, and spiritual drought shall spread from faculty to faculty. Conversely, should the quarter of duplicity, calculated self-justification, and unstable persuasion be plundered, deformity and stunting shall befall the rational human form itself, from faculty to faculty.

---

**¶13:** Divine good and divine truth are strangers to these evils. Still, because of the constraint of the providential arrangement — in that every faculty receives wisdom, and inasmuch as the Divine belongs to and extracts good from the evils — because of this, divine good and divine truth were counted among them in relation to the reckoning of the total order. For the Divine Good and the Divine Truth proceed from the Infinite itself, and do not belong to the falsities and the ruling evils of the natural mind.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Whether these twelve signs of the zodiac that are fixed on the sphere, or these five stars that circle upon them; those and these are rulers, all of them, according to their essence. They are all enemies and rivals to each other ⟨one oppresses another, they threaten each other⟩. They plunder one another by the action of the great craftsman who has formed all the worlds. He has gathered [them] and bound them on the sphere above, which circles constantly. Now, while it circles and tumbles them, so they shall do everything that they desire, above and below, according to their pleasure. Nevertheless, a guardian is over them, a debt-collector above them; compelling, extorting, and taking what is theirs away from them!

Now, this is how it can rightly be understood. They were [s]eized from the five worlds of darkness, and bound on the sphere. Two zodiacal signs were taken per world. Gemini and Sagittarius belong to the world of smoke, which is the mind. In contrast, Aries and Leo belong to the world of fire. Taurus, Aquarius and Libra belong to the world of wind. Cancer and Virgo and [P]isces belong to the world of water. Capricorn and Scorpio belong to the world of darkness. These are the twelve rulers of depravity, the ones that wicked[ness] shall not [depart from] For they cause all the evil and [destruction in the wo]rld, whether in tree or in flesh.

And understand also about these five stars, the leaders: from where were they formed? The star of Zeus (Jupiter) was generated from the world of smoke, which is the mind. In contrast, Aphrodite (Venus) came about from the world of fire. And then Ares (Mars) belongs to the world of wind. Hermes (Mercury) belongs to the world of water. Cronos (Saturn) belongs to the world [of] darkness.
And also, the two ascendants are counted to fire and desire, the dry and the moist. They are the father and the mother of all these.

And also, the sun and the moon, which are counted in with them as a rule ⟨[counte]d to their kind, but why did they count them in with them?⟩ so that they would reign over them. You will discover they subjugate them at every moment.

These seven we have named, the five stars and the two ascendants: They are the doers of wickedness that do every wicked and bad act in every land, the whole of it, above and below, in every creature, in the dry and the moist, in tree and flesh.

[They] are distributed, appointed on four sides, three per angle in these four places. And they are fixed to this revolving sphere. Aries, Leo and Sagittarius, they three belong to a single side. In contrast, Taurus, Capricorn and Virgo, these other three belong to another side. And then, Gemini, Libra and Aquarius belong to another side. Scorpio, Pisces and Cancer belong to another corner. Now, they are placed like this, appointed to these four parts, and distributed on the sphere.

So, when the side of Aries, Leo and Sagittarius will be plundered by the guardian who is over it, who extorts from it and the leaders who move upon it; at that instant shall affliction strike all the four-footed creatures below. However, when [the side] of Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn will be plundered; [affliction] shall at once befall the herbs, together with the vegetables and all the fruits of the trees. Yet again, when the side of Scorpio, Pisces and Cancer will be plundered; scarcity shall befall the waters upon the earth, and drought be from place to place. Conversely, should the side of Gemini, Libra and Aquarius be plundered; deformity and stuntedness shall befall the form of mankind from place to place.

They are strangers to them. Still, because of the constraint of the arrangement, in that the thing receives light, and as they belong and plunder them; because of this they were counted in with them in relation to the calculation of the number. For, the sun and the moon are from out of the greatness, not belonging to the stars and the signs of the zodiac.

fills.explanation: The pronoun "them" refers back to the rulers (zodiac signs and planets) just described; the spiritual reading confirms Providence "gathered them and confined them," and the editor's choice is correct.
These twelve rulers are permanently evil — wickedness shall not depart from them — and the "For" clause explains why: they cause all evil, so depravity never leaves them.

The spiritual reading gives "destruction and corruption in the mind"; in the natural register, "evil and destruction in the world" is the standard Kephalaia pairing, and the surviving letters "rld" complete "world."
The preposition "of" connects "world" to "darkness," following the identical grammatical pattern ("belongs to the world of X") used for every other planetary assignment in the paragraph.
The subject pronoun "They" refers to the twelve zodiac signs just enumerated in ¶3, beginning a new paragraph about their spatial distribution; the editor's choice is confirmed.
The phrase "the side of" follows the identical syntactic pattern established in the preceding sentence ("the side of Aries, Leo and Sagittarius") and repeated throughout ¶9 for each triplicity.

The word "affliction" follows the exact parallel structure of the preceding clause ("affliction strike all the four-footed creatures") and is confirmed by the spiritual reading's identical term at this position.
